datasets.name: ds_control
queryLines:
SELECT *,
          CASE WHEN source_row_count IS NULL OR target_row_count IS NULL THEN 'NOT CHECKED'
               WHEN source_row_count = target_row_count THEN 'MATCH'
               ELSE 'MISMATCH' END AS row_count_status
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control

datasets.name: ds_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS total_tables,
          SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED','VALIDATED')   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_tables,
          SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_tables,
          SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'QUEUED'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS queued_tables,
          SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FAILED','FAILED_PERMANENT','VALIDATION_FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tables,
          ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED','VALIDATED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS pct_complete,
          ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(size_gb),0),2) AS total_gb,
          ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED','VALIDATED') THEN size_gb ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS gb_done
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control

datasets.name: ds_cumulative
queryLines:
WITH h AS (
          SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', completed_at) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS n
          FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control
          WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','VALIDATED') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY 1)
        SELECT hour, SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY hour) AS cumulative_done
        FROM h ORDER BY hour

datasets.name: ds_throughput
queryLines:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', completed_at) AS hour,
               COUNT(*) AS tables_done,
               ROUND(SUM(size_gb),2) AS gb_done,
               ROUND(AVG(duration_seconds),1) AS avg_duration_s
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control
        WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','VALIDATED') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_failcodes
queryLines:
SELECT COALESCE(error_code,'(none)') AS error_code, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control WHERE status IN ('FAILED','FAILED_PERMANENT','VALIDATION_FAILED')
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

datasets.name: ds_failures
queryLines:
SELECT source_catalog, source_schema, source_table, status, error_code,
               error_message, attempt_number, max_attempts, batch_id, updated_at
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control WHERE status IN ('FAILED','FAILED_PERMANENT','VALIDATION_FAILED')
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 500

datasets.name: ds_attempts_daily
queryLines:
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COALESCE(status,'(unknown)') AS status, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_attempts GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_valhist_daily
queryLines:
SELECT DATE(validated_at) AS day, COALESCE(status,'(unknown)') AS status, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_validation_history GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_mismatch
queryLines:
SELECT source_schema, source_table, target_schema, target_table,
               source_version, target_version, source_row_count, target_row_count,
               validation_status, updated_at
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control
        WHERE source_row_count IS NOT NULL AND target_row_count IS NOT NULL
          AND source_row_count <> target_row_count
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 500

datasets.name: ds_longest
queryLines:
SELECT source_schema, source_table, target_schema, target_table,
               ROUND(size_gb,2) AS size_gb, duration_seconds, batch_id, status
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control WHERE duration_seconds IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY duration_seconds DESC LIMIT 50

datasets.name: ds_chunks
queryLines:
SELECT batch_id, chunk_id, COUNT(*) AS tables, ROUND(SUM(size_gb),2) AS gb,
               SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED','VALIDATED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_control WHERE chunk_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY batch_id, chunk_id ORDER BY batch_id, chunk_id

datasets.name: ds_excl
queryLines:
SELECT run_id, batch_id, source_catalog, source_schema, source_table,
               exclusion_type, exclusion_rule, excluded_at
        FROM ril_migration_catalog.migration_meta.migration_exclusion_log ORDER BY excluded_at DESC LIMIT 1000
